title: 第578章 大机缘大恐怖第577章 从现在开始我是你3
slug: 凡人修仙捡个仙子做老婆
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：凡人修仙，捡个仙子做老婆第一卷：默认第578章大机缘，大恐怖（..la）“二爷，辛苦了。”
周元深提口气，吞下十颗血玉丹后，毅然凝炼出了命血。
一成命血，蕴含一成精血，一成寿元。
寿元的抽离，感觉并不是很强烈，只是有股微妙的沉暮之感，但是那一成精血的瞬间消散，让他眼前骤黑，挺拔的腰身当即垮了下去。
那种骨缝里冒出来的冷气，浑身筋肉里透出的虚弱，让他意识都变得滞涩，几乎要昏厥过去。
体魄越是强悍，血气越是浓郁，抽离的精血越多，影响自然而然就越是强烈，但同样的，强悍的体魄，恢复速度也会更快。何况那十颗血玉丹，像是十口血井，源源不断的释放出血气。
周元缓缓坐直了身子，昏暗的眸子里泛起明光：“二爷，有了吗？”
“往前。”
二爷的声音很平静。
不是之前那种淡漠，也不是随意，甚至都没有那罕见的兴趣，似乎有些拿不准的样子。
周元心里不免紧张起来。
别闹啊。
他对祖地抱有很高期望的。
即便不是巨灵之物，也应该是罕见的异宝。
周元深提口气，起身走进洞窟，跟师姐打个招呼。
一声尖叫，在里面炸开。
周元转身走了出来，瞳孔微微放大，似是看到了了不起的东西。
“大师姐，我往深处走走。”
周元咽了口唾沫，拔腿窜进了树林里。
洞窟里，夜洛离抱着刚脱下来的衣袍，紧紧缩在地上，那张苍白的脸竟红的像是熟透的苹果。

周元提着长柄镰刀，在林间腾挪奔跃。
借着血炼岛的身份的做掩护，他随意的释放血雾，速度自然是极快。
只是二爷这一声‘往前’，他竟然足足跑了五百多里。
最后，他停到了一条峡谷前面。
说是峡谷，更像是周围地层从下面受到猛烈冲击，朝上翘起的两道断层。
两侧岩壁破碎倾斜，夹出一道幽深的裂缝，地面满是碎石和断岩，光线从顶部洒下，将里面映的明暗分明。
不需要二爷提醒，周元已经看到了他的福缘。
但那里的景象，却让他的神情渐渐凝重起来。
只见那峡谷深处，一道裂缝撕裂了空间，如同虚空被人一刀劈开，边缘粗糙扭曲。裂缝非常躁动，大量雷光不断从里面喷涌而出，冲击满地的碎石，崩裂两侧岩壁，留下道道焦黑痕迹。
虚空裂缝！！
祖地里最可怕的危险！
这是武红鸾之前提醒过的，进了祖地遇到了裂缝，一定要远远避开。稍有不慎，就可能被撕扯进去，甚至可能从里面窜出什么东西。
可现在……
他第一次命血推演的福缘，竟然就在虚空裂缝里？
周元稍稍定了定神，命血推演的，应该能拿到的吧？
只是，这福缘在虚空裂缝里，就意味着不是祖地原有的，而且显然跟巨灵没关系。
“雷系灵宝吗？”
“我要雷源有雷源，要雷刀有雷刀，还有上古吞雷术，现在不缺雷系灵宝啊。”
周元无奈叹口气。
浪费啊。

周元走进峡谷，小心翼翼的靠近着那条扭曲的空间裂缝。
尽管有信心拿到，但看着裂缝里的无尽虚空，还是有些紧张。
周元取出混元棍，在裂缝前面展开，深深插进地层，又握紧镰刀，用弯弯的刀锋勾住。接着又耸动肩膀，催动出麒麟天纹，在浑身浮现出层层叠叠的血鳞，从面部到手臂再到全身，像是护了层铠甲。
他做好准备后，一只手紧紧握住长柄，另一只手狠狠闯进裂缝，抓住了那里的雷光。
噗嗤！

Recommended reading for all book friends: A mortal cultivates immortality and picks up a fairy to be his wife. Volume 1: Default Chapter 578 Great opportunity, great terror (..la) "Second Master, thank you for your hard work."
Zhou Yuan took a deep breath, swallowed ten blood jade pills, and resolutely condensed the life blood.
One percent of life blood contains 10 percent of essence and blood, and 10 percent of life span.
The feeling of Shouyuan's withdrawal was not very strong, just a subtle feeling of twilight, but the 10% of blood essence and blood dissipated instantly, causing his eyes to darken suddenly, and his tall waist collapsed immediately.
The cold air coming out of the cracks in his bones and the weakness in his muscles made his consciousness become stagnant and he almost fainted.
The stronger the body, the richer the blood, and the more essence and blood are extracted, the stronger the impact will naturally be, but similarly, a strong body will recover faster. What's more, those ten blood jade pills are like ten blood wells, releasing blood energy continuously.
Zhou Yuan slowly sat up straight, his dim eyes filled with light: "Second Master, are you ready?"
"Move forward."
The second master’s voice was very calm.
It's not the indifference, nor the casualness, or even that rare interest, it seems a little unsure.
Zhou Yuan couldn't help but feel nervous.
Don't make trouble.
He has high hopes for his ancestral land.
Even if it is not a giant spirit thing, it should be a rare treasure.
Zhou Yuan took a deep breath, stood up and walked into the cave to say hello to his senior sister.
A scream exploded inside.
Zhou Yuan turned around and walked out, his pupils slightly dilated, as if he had seen something amazing.
"Sister, let me go deeper."
Zhou Yuan swallowed and ran into the woods.
In the cave, Ye Luoli hugged the robe he had just taken off and huddled tightly on the ground. His pale face was as red as a ripe apple.
Zhou Yuan held a long-handled sickle and ran around in the forest.
Using the cover of Blood Refining Island, he released the blood mist at will, naturally at an extremely fast speed.
Just when the second master said "move forward", he actually ran for more than five hundred miles.
Finally, he stopped in front of a canyon.
It is said that it is a canyon, but it is more like two faults that are upwards due to the violent impact of the surrounding strata from below.
The rock walls on both sides were broken and tilted, creating a deep crack. The ground was full of gravel and broken rocks. Light fell from the top, reflecting light and dark inside.
There was no need for Second Master to remind him, Zhou Yuan had already seen his good fortune.
But the scene there gradually made his expression serious.
I saw a crack tearing apart the space deep in the canyon, like the void being split open with a knife, and the edges were rough and twisted. The crack was very restless, and a large amount of lightning continuously spurted out from it, impacting the gravel on the ground, cracking the rock walls on both sides, leaving behind traces of scorched black marks.
Void crack! !
The most terrifying danger in the ancestral land!
This is what Wu Hongluan had reminded before. If you encounter a crack in the ancestral land, you must stay away from it. If you are not careful, it may be torn in, and something may even come out of it.
But now...
The fate of his first life-blood deduction was actually in the crack in the void?
Zhou Yuan calmed down a little, he should be able to get it based on the life blood deduction, right?
However, this blessing is in the void crack, which means that it is not original to the ancestral land, and it obviously has nothing to do with the giant spirit.
"Thunder-type spiritual treasure?"
"I want a thunder source with a thunder source, a thunder sword with a thunder sword, and the ancient lightning swallowing technique. There is no shortage of lightning spiritual treasures now."
Zhou Yuan sighed helplessly.
What a waste.
Zhou Yuan walked into the canyon and cautiously approached the twisted space crack.
Although I was confident of getting it, I was still a little nervous looking at the endless void in the crack.
Zhou Yuan took out the Hunyuan stick, unfolded it in front of the crack, inserted it deeply into the ground, then held the sickle tightly, and hooked it with the curved blade. Then he shrugged his shoulders, activated the Qilin Sky Pattern, and layers of blood scales appeared all over his body.His face, arms, and entire body seemed to be covered in armor.
After he was ready, he held the long handle tightly with one hand, and broke into the crack with the other hand to grab the lightning there.
Poof!
